topic: Introduction to roles of Air Arm of the Indian Navy
syllabus_extract: Introduction to roles of Air Arm of the Indian Navy.
specific_objectives: 39.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to enumerate roles of Air Arm of the Indian Navy and introduce about IN aircrafts, its roles and operating squadrons/ flights.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

intro_questions: What is the primary function of the Indian Navy?
Can you name one major naval air base in India?
What is the general purpose of naval aviation?

development.content:
Strategic Deterrence Role
Anti-Submarine Warfare
Anti-Surface Warfare
Air Superiority Missions
Search and Rescue Operations

Helicopter Squadrons Types
Fixed Wing Aircraft Roles

summary_questions: List three primary combat roles of the Indian Navy Air Arm.
Explain how naval helicopters differ from fixed-wing aircraft in mission profiles.
Describe the relationship between carrier-based squadrons and land-based air stations.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific roles of the INS Viraat and INS Vikramaditya squadrons to be discussed in the next lesson on Air Squadrons/Flights.
